description.value: Wendy's at 1813 Cranbrook Street North is the sole Wendy's franchise in Cranbrook, situated on the city's main commercial strip in BC's southeastern Rocky Mountain Trench corridor. The menu spans burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, and Frosty desserts, with drive-through and mobile ordering available for quick stops. Touring cyclists on routes through the Kootenays will find it a predictable, high-capacity food option in an otherwise limited fast-food landscape.
